model: I'd say university should be free, or at least much cheaper, for students who can't afford it. The main reason is fairness. Tuition fees create a barrier, so bright students from a low-income background often give up on university. Free education would create a more level playing field. In my parents' generation, for example, many talented people used to leave school early to support their families, and my uncle would always say he'd missed his chance. It's also an investment in the future, because a country with a skilled workforce attracts more business and collects more tax later. Some European countries, like Germany, no longer charge tuition fees at public universities, and they still have strong economies. On the other hand, free education comes at a cost. It has to be funded by taxpayers, including people who never went to university, and universities might get overcrowded. So maybe the best solution is free tuition for poorer students and affordable loans for others, so nobody has to get into huge debt.
